reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 客户端聊天输入区提供一次性“打断发送”操作：在会话进行且草稿存在时，用户可中断当前回合并立即提交草稿；默认回车发送策略仍保留，故属于面向聊天工作流的轻量自动化界面工具。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的输入区工具栏新增可选的“打断发送”按钮，可在会话进行中中断当前回合并立即提交当前草稿消息。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an optional interrupt-send button to the DeepSeek Harness composer toolbar so users can cancel the active turn and immediately submit their current draft message.

capabilities: Adds a conversation composer control to interrupt a running turn
Submits the current draft immediately as the next message
Uses existing session cancel API before sending when available
Keeps default Enter behavior unchanged as an optional path
Falls back to normal queued send if interruption fails

reasons.code: Repository README states the plugin adds an interrupt-send button in the composer tool row.
README describes behavior that the button appears during AI running with non-empty draft, calls session.cancel(), then submits the draft message.
Package manifest config marks it as a web client plugin injecting slots and locale with immediate client-side startup.
